title: Backend Developer
description: Builds the server-side logic, APIs and databases that power web and mobile applications.
project_ideas: URL shortener with analytics, rate limiting and caching
E-commerce REST API with auth, payments sandbox and order workflow
Real-time chat service using WebSockets and Redis pub/sub
certifications: Oracle Certified Professional: Java SE Developer

scenarios.question: Your API endpoint that lists orders has become slow as the table grew to 10 million rows. How would you investigate and fix it?
scenarios.ideal: Measure first (logs, APM, EXPLAIN), add the right composite index, paginate with keyset/cursor pagination, avoid N+1 queries, cache hot reads, and archive old data if needed.

title: Frontend Developer
description: Creates the interactive, accessible and fast user interfaces people use in the browser.
project_ideas: Personal portfolio with dark mode, animations and a Lighthouse score above 95
Kanban board with drag and drop and offline persistence
Movie discovery app consuming a public API with search, filters and infinite scroll

scenarios.question: Users complain that your React dashboard feels laggy when typing in a search box over a list of 5,000 items. What would you do?
scenarios.ideal: Profile with React DevTools, debounce the input, memoize derived data with useMemo/React.memo, virtualize the list (windowing), and keep state local to avoid re-rendering the whole tree.

title: Full Stack Developer
description: Owns features end to end, from the user interface through APIs to the database and deployment.
project_ideas: MERN-stack job board with authentication, roles and resume upload
Expense splitter app with a REST API, charts and email reminders
Collaborative notes app with real-time sync

scenarios.question: You need to add login to an existing web app. Describe how you would implement authentication securely across frontend and backend.
scenarios.ideal: Hash passwords with bcrypt/argon2, issue a session or short-lived JWT plus refresh token stored in an HttpOnly Secure cookie, protect against CSRF, enforce HTTPS, rate-limit login, and validate tokens on every API request.

title: Mobile App Developer
description: Designs and builds native or cross-platform apps for Android and iOS devices.
project_ideas: Habit tracker with local database, notifications and widgets
Campus marketplace app with Firebase auth and image upload
Offline-first news reader with caching and dark mode

scenarios.question: Your app is getting poor reviews for battery drain and slowness on low-end phones. How do you diagnose and fix it?
scenarios.ideal: Use platform profilers to find main-thread work and memory leaks, batch/background network calls with WorkManager, compress and cache images, reduce wake-locks and polling, and test on low-end devices.

title: Data Scientist
description: Uses statistics and machine learning to extract insights and build predictive models from data.
project_ideas: Customer churn prediction with feature engineering and SHAP explanations
House price regression with a deployed Streamlit app
A/B test analysis of a marketing campaign with a written report

scenarios.question: Your fraud detection model has 99% accuracy but the business says it misses most fraud. What is going on and how would you fix it?
scenarios.ideal: The data is imbalanced, so accuracy is misleading. Evaluate with precision, recall, F1 and PR-AUC; use class weights, resampling (SMOTE/undersampling), tune the decision threshold for business cost, and monitor recall on fraud.

title: Data Analyst
description: Turns raw business data into dashboards, reports and recommendations that drive decisions.
project_ideas: Sales performance dashboard in Power BI with drill-downs
SQL analysis of an e-commerce dataset answering 10 business questions
Excel model analysing student performance trends
certifications: Microsoft PL-300: Power BI Data Analyst

scenarios.question: Monthly revenue dropped 15% and your manager asks why by tomorrow. How would you approach it?
scenarios.ideal: Validate data quality first, then break revenue down by segment (region, product, channel, customer cohort), compare against seasonality and last year, form and test hypotheses, and present the top drivers with a clear chart and recommendation.

title: Machine Learning Engineer
description: Builds, deploys and scales machine learning models as reliable production systems.
project_ideas: Image classifier served via FastAPI in Docker with monitoring
End-to-end ML pipeline with MLflow tracking and CI retraining
Recommendation system with offline evaluation and an online API

scenarios.question: A model that performed well offline is performing poorly two months after deployment. How do you handle it?
scenarios.ideal: Check for data drift and concept drift by comparing feature and prediction distributions with training data, verify the feature pipeline (training/serving skew), set up monitoring and alerts, retrain on recent data, and use shadow/canary deployments with rollback.

title: AI / LLM Engineer
description: Builds products on top of large language models: RAG systems, agents, evaluations and AI features.
project_ideas: RAG chatbot over your college's documents with citations and an evaluation set
AI resume reviewer that scores resumes against job descriptions
Tool-using agent that books meetings from natural language

scenarios.question: Your RAG chatbot sometimes answers confidently with information that is not in the documents. How would you reduce this?
scenarios.ideal: Improve retrieval quality (chunking, embeddings, hybrid search, reranking), instruct the model to answer only from retrieved context and cite sources, allow it to say it does not know, and build an evaluation set to measure groundedness before and after each change.

title: Data Engineer
description: Designs the pipelines and warehouses that move, clean and store data at scale.
project_ideas: Airflow pipeline ingesting public API data into a warehouse with dbt models
Real-time clickstream processing with Kafka and Spark Streaming
Data quality checks and alerting for a daily ETL job

scenarios.question: A nightly ETL job that used to take 1 hour now takes 6 hours and sometimes fails. What would you do?
scenarios.ideal: Find the bottleneck from logs and metrics, switch full loads to incremental loads, partition data and fix skew, parallelise independent tasks, make steps idempotent with retries, and add monitoring/alerts on duration and row counts.

title: DevOps Engineer
description: Automates building, testing, deploying and operating software reliably at scale.
project_ideas: CI/CD pipeline that tests, builds a Docker image and deploys to Kubernetes
Infrastructure for a 3-tier app on AWS written in Terraform
Prometheus + Grafana monitoring stack with alerting for a sample app

scenarios.question: A deployment just went out and error rates spiked to 20%. Walk me through what you do in the next 30 minutes.
scenarios.ideal: Declare an incident and communicate, check dashboards/logs to confirm correlation with the deploy, roll back quickly to restore service, then investigate root cause, add tests or canary checks, and write a blameless postmortem.

title: Cloud Engineer / Architect
description: Designs secure, scalable and cost-efficient systems on cloud platforms.
project_ideas: Highly available web app across two availability zones with auto scaling
Serverless image-processing pipeline with event triggers
Cloud cost dashboard and right-sizing recommendations

scenarios.question: Design the infrastructure for an exam-results website that gets 100x normal traffic for one hour when results are announced.
scenarios.ideal: Serve results as cached/static content behind a CDN, put a load balancer with autoscaling in front of stateless app servers, pre-warm capacity, use read replicas or a cache for lookups, queue writes, and load test beforehand.

title: Cybersecurity Analyst
description: Protects organisations by monitoring threats, finding vulnerabilities and responding to incidents.
project_ideas: Home SOC lab with a SIEM ingesting logs and detection rules
Vulnerability assessment of a deliberately vulnerable app (DVWA/Juice Shop) with a report
Phishing email analyser that flags suspicious links and headers

scenarios.question: An employee reports that they clicked a link in a suspicious email and entered their password. What do you do?
scenarios.ideal: Contain first: reset the password, revoke sessions and enforce MFA; check sign-in and mailbox logs for misuse, isolate the device if malware is suspected, block the sender/domain, search for other recipients, document the incident and run awareness follow-up.

title: UI/UX Designer
description: Researches user needs and designs intuitive, beautiful digital experiences.
project_ideas: Redesign case study of a government or college website with usability testing
Design system with components, tokens and documentation in Figma
Mobile app for a local business from research to high-fidelity prototype

scenarios.question: Analytics show 60% of users drop off on the sign-up screen of your app. How would you find out why and improve it?
scenarios.ideal: Analyse the funnel to find the exact step, run usability tests and short interviews to see the friction, form hypotheses (too many fields, unclear value, errors), prototype simplifications such as fewer fields or social login, and validate with an A/B test.

title: Product Manager
description: Decides what to build and why, aligning users, business goals and engineering teams.
project_ideas: Product teardown and improvement proposal for an app you use daily
PRD with user stories, metrics and a launch plan for a new feature
Run a small survey + interviews and synthesise them into a prioritised roadmap

scenarios.question: Sales wants feature A for a big client, engineering wants to fix tech debt, and users are asking for feature B. You can only do one this quarter. How do you decide?
scenarios.ideal: Anchor on company goals and metrics, estimate impact, reach, confidence and effort (e.g. RICE), gather data on each option, discuss trade-offs openly with stakeholders, make and document the decision, and communicate the rationale and what comes next.

title: Business Analyst
description: Bridges business and technology by analysing processes, gathering requirements and recommending solutions.
project_ideas: Process map and improvement proposal for a college admission workflow
BRD and user stories for a library management system
KPI dashboard for a small business with recommendations
certifications: Microsoft PL-300: Power BI Data Analyst

scenarios.question: Two departments give you conflicting requirements for the same system. How do you resolve it?
scenarios.ideal: Understand the underlying goal of each department, document both requirements clearly, bring stakeholders together to discuss trade-offs against business objectives, propose options, escalate to the sponsor if needed, and get written sign-off.

title: Digital Marketing Specialist
description: Grows brands and sales through SEO, social media, content and paid campaigns.
project_ideas: Grow an Instagram page or blog for 60 days and report the metrics
SEO audit of a local business website with an action plan
Run a small Google Ads campaign with a fixed budget and analyse ROAS

scenarios.question: You have a budget of 50,000 rupees to launch a new product online. How would you plan and measure the campaign?
scenarios.ideal: Define the target audience and goal, choose channels that reach them, split budget with a test-and-scale approach, set KPIs (CTR, CPA, conversions, ROAS), set up tracking with analytics/UTM tags, A/B test creatives, and reallocate budget to what performs.

title: Embedded Systems / IoT Engineer
description: Programs microcontrollers and builds connected devices that interact with the physical world.
project_ideas: Smart irrigation system with soil sensors, ESP32 and a mobile dashboard
RTOS-based data logger with SD card and low-power modes
Gesture-controlled robot using an accelerometer

scenarios.question: Your battery-powered sensor node should last a year but the battery dies in two weeks. How do you fix it?
scenarios.ideal: Measure current in each state, put the MCU in deep sleep and wake on timer/interrupt, reduce duty cycle and radio on-time, batch transmissions, lower clock speed, and disable unused peripherals and pull-ups.

title: Game Developer
description: Builds gameplay systems, mechanics and interactive worlds for PC, console and mobile games.
project_ideas: 2D platformer with three levels, enemies and a save system
Multiplayer party game prototype
Physics-based puzzle game published on itch.io

scenarios.question: Your mobile game drops to 20 FPS when many enemies are on screen. How would you optimise it?
scenarios.ideal: Profile CPU/GPU first, use object pooling to avoid allocations and GC spikes, reduce draw calls with batching and texture atlases, use LOD and culling, simplify physics and move work out of Update loops.

title: Blockchain Developer
description: Builds smart contracts and decentralised applications on blockchain platforms.
project_ideas: ERC-20 token and a staking contract with tests
Decentralised voting dApp with a React frontend
NFT certificate issuance system for college events

scenarios.question: How would you make sure a smart contract that holds user funds is secure before deploying it?
scenarios.ideal: Follow checks-effects-interactions and use reentrancy guards, add access control, use audited libraries like OpenZeppelin, write thorough unit and fuzz tests, run static analysis (Slither), deploy to a testnet, and get an independent audit.

title: QA / Test Automation Engineer
description: Ensures software quality through test strategy, automated test suites and release validation.
project_ideas: Selenium/Playwright test suite for a demo e-commerce site using page objects
API test collection with Postman/Newman running in CI
Test plan and bug reports for an open-source app

scenarios.question: Your automated UI test suite is flaky: about 10% of tests fail randomly. How do you fix it?
scenarios.ideal: Find patterns in failures from logs/screenshots, replace sleeps with explicit waits, use stable locators, isolate tests and their test data, stabilise the environment, quarantine flaky tests while fixing them, and move checks down to the API level where possible.

title: Network Engineer
description: Designs, configures and maintains the networks that connect organisations and data centres.
project_ideas: Campus network design in Cisco Packet Tracer with VLANs and ACLs
Network monitoring setup with SNMP and Grafana
Python script to back up and audit router configurations

scenarios.question: Users on one floor can reach internal servers but not the internet. How do you troubleshoot?
scenarios.ideal: Work up the OSI layers: check link and VLAN, verify IP configuration and default gateway, ping the gateway and an external IP, test DNS separately, traceroute to see where traffic stops, and check NAT, firewall rules and routing for that subnet.

title: Technical Writer
description: Explains complex products clearly through documentation, guides and API references.
project_ideas: Rewrite the README and getting-started guide of an open-source project
API reference with examples for a public API
Docs site built with a static site generator and docs-as-code workflow

scenarios.question: Developers say your product's documentation is hard to use. How would you improve it?
scenarios.ideal: Gather feedback and analytics to find where users struggle, define audiences and their tasks, restructure into tutorials, how-tos, reference and concepts, add runnable examples and a quick start, improve search, and set a style guide and review process.

title: Financial Analyst
description: Analyses financial data, builds models and advises on investments and business decisions.
project_ideas: DCF valuation of a listed Indian company with sensitivity analysis
Personal finance dashboard tracking expenses and investments
Ratio analysis comparing three companies in the same sector

scenarios.question: A company's profits are growing but its cash balance keeps falling. What could explain this and what would you check?
scenarios.ideal: Profit is accrual-based while cash is not. Check the cash flow statement: growing receivables or inventory (working capital), heavy capex, debt repayments or dividends. Analyse days sales outstanding and inventory days and recommend collection or inventory improvements.

title: HR / Talent Acquisition Specialist
description: Hires, develops and supports people, shaping company culture and employee experience.
project_ideas: Design a structured interview process and scorecard for a role
Employee engagement survey with analysis and action plan
Onboarding playbook for new hires at a startup

scenarios.question: A hiring manager rejects every candidate you send and the role has been open for three months. What do you do?
scenarios.ideal: Hold a calibration meeting to clarify must-have versus nice-to-have criteria, update the job description, agree on a scorecard, collect specific feedback on rejected candidates, share market data on availability and salary, and adjust sourcing channels.
